about: Draft impact recipes for Take Action (8.13.0), written by WIOF for admins to check in Admin → Take Action (Impact). Conservative: the low end of typical values. Applied by scripts/apply-action-impacts.js as status 'draft'; reviewed recipes are never overwritten. Actions without an honest, measurable saving (Spirit actions, sorting waste, repairing, borrowing, seasonal food, planting) have none on purpose.

impacts.assumption: An LED bulb uses about 9 W (older bulbs use much more).
Counts a ceiling fan at about 50 W. Switching off an AC saves far more (about 1.5 kW).
A device on standby draws about 1 W.
An LED bulb uses about 9 W.
Heating the water is most of a washing machine's energy: about 0.3 kWh for a warm load.

impacts.inputLabel: Loads air-dried instead of using a dryer
impacts.assumption: Counts only if you'd otherwise use a tumble dryer, at about 2 kWh a load.

impacts.inputLabel: Minutes the tap would have run
impacts.assumption: A tap runs at about 6 litres a minute.
A shower uses about 8 litres a minute.

impacts.inputLabel: Minutes the water would have kept running
impacts.assumption: A tap runs at about 6 litres a minute.

impacts.inputLabel: Days the leak would have kept dripping
impacts.assumption: A slowly dripping tap wastes about 15 litres a day.
Instead of an average petrol car (about 15 km a litre, 2.31 kg CO₂ a litre).
Instead of an average petrol car (about 15 km a litre, 2.31 kg CO₂ a litre).

impacts.inputLabel: Kilometres by bus or train instead of car
impacts.assumption: A car emits about 0.15 kg CO₂ a km; your share of a bus or train is much less. Counts the difference, about 0.1 kg a km.
Two people in one car instead of two: half the car's 0.154 kg CO₂ a km.
An average petrol car emits about 0.154 kg CO₂ a km.
Instead of a meal with meat (chicken, the lowest of the common meats): about 0.5 kg CO₂ less.
Each refill instead of buying water is one plastic bottle avoided.
Each time you use your own bag is one plastic bag avoided.
Each reuse is one new container you didn't need.
About 100 g of food not left on the plate.

impacts.inputLabel: Portions eaten instead of thrown away
impacts.assumption: A portion is about 200 g of food.
A meal is about 300 g of food.
